 View image in fullscreen Heavy rain floods displaced families’ tents in Gaza – in pictures 
 The first winter storm began affecting the people of Gaza this weekend with heavy rain hitting on Saturday. Reports that about 70,000 tents were flooded within 12 hours prompted warnings of a worsening humanitarian situation for hundreds of thousands of displaced people living in temporary camps lacking adequate protection from rain and cold
 Displaced Palestinians struggle to cope with heavy rain and strong winds as a low-pressure weather system hits Gaza City. Photograph: Mohammed M Skaik/JNA/Zuma Press Wire/Shutterstock Sun 8 Nov 2026 13.50 EST Last modified on Sun 8 Nov 2026 13.57 EST Share View image in fullscreen Displaced Palestinians attempt to repair their damaged tents and cover gaps with plastic sheeting after heavy rain and strong winds in western Gaza City Photograph: Mohammed Salha/APAImages/Shutterstock Share View image in fullscreen Families struggled to repair their worn shelters using basic tools and frayed ropes amid severe shortages of tarpaulins and insulation materials, raising concerns that the tents may collapse during
